sources.title: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is a policy gradient reinforcement learning algorithm that learns an optimal policy by directly updating the agent's action-selection strategy while maintaining stable learning. Unlike traditional policy gradient methods that can make overly large policy updates, PPO introduces a clipping mechanism that limits how much the policy can change during each update ...

sources.title: Proximal Policy Optimization | OpenAI
sources.snippet: We're releasing a new class of reinforcement learning algorithms, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which perform comparably or better than state-of-the-art approaches while being much simpler to implement and tune. PPO has become the default reinforcement learning algorithm at OpenAI because of its ease of use and good performance.
